mapper.select: SELECT s.id as staff_id, s.sname as staff_name, s.depart_id, d.dname as depart_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.transaction_type = 'EARN' THEN wp.points_value ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_earned, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.transaction_type = 'USE' THEN wp.used_points ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_used, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.transaction_type = 'EARN' THEN wp.points_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN wp.transaction_type = 'USE' THEN wp.used_points ELSE 0 END), 0) as current_balance, subquery.my_rank as rank FROM hr_employee s LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON s.depart_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hr_welfare_points wp ON s.id = wp.staff_id AND wp.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT staff_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'EARN' THEN points_value ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'USE' THEN used_points ELSE 0 END), 0) DESC ) as my_rank FROM hr_welfare_points WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY staff_id ) subquery ON s.id = subquery.staff_id WHERE s.id = #{staffId} AND s.status = '正常' GROUP BY s.id, s.sname, s.depart_id, d.dname, subquery.my_rank
